Data.subject: Individual Living Arrangement
Data.title: Residents In Resident Households By Living Arrangement, Age Group And Sex, Annual
Data.footnote: Data for 2010 and 2020 are based on the Census of Population while data for 2015 and 2025 are based on the General Household Survey. Data for all other years are based on the Comprehensive June Labour Force Survey. Survey estimates are subject to sampling variability. Data on living arrangement are as declared by survey respondents. The presence of spouse/ children/ parents is based on those living in the same household and is regardless of age. Children and parents include in-laws. Relatively small counts are observed for selected cells due to less common living arrangements among specific age groups (e.g. living with only domestic worker(s) in household among those aged below 65, living in one-person household or living with spouse and/or children among those aged below 25). These categories have been included for completeness. Users are advised to exercise caution when using these breakdowns as the survey estimates are subject to higher sampling variability arising from smaller sample sizes.
